title: Bible Verse for When You're Running on Empty | Isaiah 40:31 KJV
caption: Running on empty this morning? Pray this before the day starts. Isaiah 40:31 KJV: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint. Eagles don't flap their way up; the wind carries them. Waiting on God means you keep working, but you let Him carry the weight. Send this to somebody who's worn out, and drop an amen. Derrick Hughes is an AI-generated presenter. The Word is real. #MorningPrayer #BibleVerse #Isaiah40 #KJV #BlessedPrayers
